column1: # tests/standins/11.tsv: what a person produces, for phase 11, at manual steps (see tests/standin.py)
# DC-5.2 (03): the signed key table, merged on main with its review record (03 DC-1.3), and its file name
# written in the Record column of the KEYS row of decisions/TRACKER.md, as signing a record does (03 DC-1.4).
# 11 KV-0.1 reads KEY_TABLE_RECORD from that row on origin/main; nobody types it.

column3:
cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && mkdir -p decisions && printf '# %s — Key table

- **Status:** accepted
- **Ids:** KEYS SD-47

| Ring | Project | Location | Keys | Created in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| logging | KMS_PROJECT | europe-west1 | platform-logs-europe-west1 | 11 |
| gemini | KMS_PROJECT | europe | gemini-cmek (manual rotation) | 11 |
| engines | KMS_PROJECT | europe-west1 | <agent>-engine-cmek | 11 |
| supply-chain | CICD_PROJECT | europe-west1 | binauthz-vuln-gated, binauthz-promoted | 11 |
| eve | EVE_PROJECT | europe-west1 | eve-evidence, eve-approval | 23 |
| eve-eu | EVE_PROJECT | europe | eve-evidence-eu | 23 |

Autokey: the five folders of 11 KV-6. Test stand-in for a record signed per DC-1.4.
' "$(date -u +%F)" > decisions/$DATE-key-table.md && { [ ! -f decisions/TRACKER.md ] || { awk -v r="$DATE-key-table.md" 'BEGIN {FS = OFS = "|"} {k = $2; gsub(/ /, "", k); if (k == "KEYS") $4 = " " r " "} 1' decisions/TRACKER.md > decisions/TRACKER.md.new && mv decisions/TRACKER.md.new decisions/TRACKER.md && git add decisions/TRACKER.md; }; } && git add decisions/$DATE-key-table.md && git commit -qm "DC-5.2 key table record" && c=$(git -C "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" rev-parse HEAD) && mkdir -p "$BUILD_LOG_DIR/reviews" && printf 'commit %s
reviewer: %s
date: %s
result: approved
evidence: %s-DC-5.2-review-v1
' "$c" "second human, bootstrap reviewer (test stand-in)" "$(date -u +%F)" "$(date -u +%F)" > "$BUILD_LOG_DIR/reviews/$c.md" && { git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true; }
